prompt.garment: a boxy cropped hooded puffer jacket in frosted translucent white ripstop that reveals the cloudy white padding inside, quilting stitched in sharp zig-zag lightning bolt shaped panels across the chest and sleeves, white zip, elastic cuffs, integrated hood
prompt.pose: zipped up with the hood down, wide light grey sweatpants, white chunky sneakers, silver wraparound sunglasses; arms out slightly showing the puffy volume

products.name: Racing Leather Jacket

products.name: Crystal Wing Denim

details: Alas de pedrería en la espalda
